{{Quote|Long ago, in the time of the Old Republic, Annamar was the base of a manufacturing company. Their factory specialized in experimental battle droids. The Rebels use the abandoned droid factory as their headquarters.|[[Luca/Legends|Luca]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="SWA" />}}
By approximately [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], an '''abandoned droid factory''' existed on the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[Annamar]].

==History==
[[File:Abandoned_Annamar_factory.jpg|thumb|left|210px|The droid factory during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]]]
Formerly a manufacturing facility specializing in experimental [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] during the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] the factory had been appropriated as a military base by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="SWA" />
